hypothesis.statement: The currently available official Palworld sources are sufficient to label PAL ATLAS breeding formulas and recipe results as verified current game facts.

officialEvidence.claim: The current official Palworld Server Guide identifies its documentation version as 1.0.0.
The current official technology ID list includes BreedFarm / 配合牧場, confirming breeding remains a supported game system.

repositoryEvidence.reason: Registered cross-check sources are not all machine-ingested as field-level claims, so absence of disagreement cannot be treated as agreement.

result.productPolicy: Keep PAL ATLAS breeding outputs explicitly derived/source-bound. Do not present the rank formula or special recipe table as official or verified-current until evidence closes the field-level authority gap.

reversalConditions: A Pocketpair primary source publishes or exposes the breeding-result rule at field level, including enough semantics to reproduce the rank formula used by PAL ATLAS.
Special recipe identities used by PAL ATLAS are covered by authoritative current-version evidence with unresolved identity conflicts equal to zero.
The repository persists the comparison artifact and deterministic validation passes on the exact revision being released.
